newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Banca Agricola cuts deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Romania Banca Agricola cuts deposit rates.

text.p: Romanian state bank Banca Agricola SA said it was lowering interest rates on leu term deposits starting Wednesday.

The bank said in a statement the rate on corporates' one-month deposits fell to an annual 40 percent from a previous 43 percent, while corporates' three-month to one-year deposits were bearing 43 percent interest, down from 45 previously.
It did not say why it was making the changes.
Interest rates on individual deposits slipped to 40 percent annually from 45 for one month and to 58 percent from 60 for three months.
Individual six-month deposits now bear an interest of 45 percent a year, down from 47, and nine-month deposits pay 46 percent, down from 48.
The bank said annual interest on individual one-year deposits was now 50 percent, down from 52 percent previously.
Sight deposit rates stayed flat at an annual 16 percent.

Banca Agricola farm lender is a leading state-run bank likely to turn private under a bank selloff bill which is expected to clear parliament after Romania's presidential and parliamentary polls scheduled for November 3. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
